latestVersion.changelog:
Text to Video Free 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly convert text prompts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, or pasted text up to 500MB) into ready-to-share 1080p MP4 videos.
- No camera or editing skills needed — just upload your content and describe how you'd like it transformed.
- Supports background music, aspect ratio, text overlays, and visual customization via guided prompts.
- All processing happens on remote GPU nodes; no local install required.
- Includes session management, free token on first use, job status updates, and easy download links for finished videos.
- Error handling and workflow tips for a smooth editing experience.
